dc:title: Six reported monthly averages with approximate weighted totals

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Identifies a reported aggregate with derived values or an entirely synthetic illustration; never an observed Canadian client outcome.

columns.name: displayed_average_monthly_deletions
columns.dc:description: Publisher-displayed monthly mean for this period; source rounding rule is not known.

columns.name: start
columns.dc:description: First included calendar date of the period.

columns.name: end_exclusive
columns.dc:description: First excluded calendar date of the period.

columns.name: months
columns.dc:description: Number of months used to weight the reported monthly mean.

columns.name: implied_deletions_from_displayed_mean
columns.dc:description: Monthly mean × months; approximate reconstruction, not an exact observed event count.

columns.name: source_url
columns.dc:description: Attribution URL for reported values; blank for original constructed examples.

columns.name: notes
columns.dc:description: Interpretation limits and assumptions for this row.
